[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided a lemon curd recipe with the following details:  
[ASSISTANT] Ingredients for lemon curd: 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar, 1/2 cup (120ml) freshly squeezed lemon juice, 1/4 cup (60g) unsalted butter (softened), 2 large egg yolks, 1 tsp (5g) grated lemon zest, salt (optional).  
[ASSISTANT] Instructions for making lemon curd: whisk together sugar, lemon juice, and salt; add butter; temper egg yolks; cook until thickened; stir in lemon zest; strain through a fine-mesh sieve.  
[ASSISTANT] Tips for using lemon curd as a filling: use a pastry bag or spatula for cake filling, spread in a pre-baked tart crust, ensure curd is at room temperature, use about 1-2 tablespoons per serving, refrigerate assembled desserts, balance tartness with sweet components, and make ahead.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested popular dessert ideas using lemon curd: lemon curd-filled vanilla or lemon sponge cakes, lemon curd tarts with fresh berries or meringue topping, lemon curd-filled eclairs or cream puffs, lemon curd-topped cheesecakes or brownies, lemon curd-filled crepes or waffles.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in achieving the perfect balance of flavors in lemon desserts.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips for balancing flavors in lemon desserts: use high-quality ingredients, balance sweet and sour, consider lemon types, avoid over-lemoning, pair with complementary flavors, use citrus zest, adjust for acidity, taste and adjust, consider sugar types, and experiment.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips for incorporating lemon zest into baking: grate fresh zest, use the right amount, pair with lemon juice, add to dry ingredients, use in sweet and savory recipes, make lemon sugar, infuse into creamy desserts, combine with other citrus, use in syrups and glazes, and store properly.
